focus: Ability.Activate postfixes for discovery; also: can you find why Hediff_Titan.Notify_PawnUsedVerb did NOT discover a trait when its granted FireSpew-copy ability was cast (user saw discovery only once the fire injured a pawn)?
diffSource: since build 32 (2026-10-06T04:59:24Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: The Ability.Activate postfix cannot explain or fix the missed fire breath discovery; the comment claiming it does is unproven
findings.detail: For a Verb_CastAbility ability (TF_Example_FireBreath), Ability.Activate runs inside Verb.TryCastNextBurstShot via TryCastShot (Verb_CastAbility.cs:61). The same method then calls CasterPawn.health.Notify_UsedVerb at Verb.cs:497, which reaches Hediff_Titan.Notify_PawnUsedVerb with an IAbilityVerb whose Ability.def is TF_Example_FireBreath. Both paths go through the same TitanTrait.TryDiscoverBy gates (discovered, DiscoveredBy, PlayerCanObserve; TitanTrait.cs:53), a few lines apart in one call. Whatever stopped discovery in run #31 stops the postfix too, unless something threw in between (that would be in that run's log). Change the doc comment at TitanAI.cs:119-121 so it doesn't state that Notify_PawnUsedVerb missed the cast, and don't report the bug fixed until a run reproduces it.

findings.title: Postfix reveals the trait even when Activate returned false (failed psycast)
findings.detail: Psycast.Activate returns false without casting when entropy can't be added (Psycast.cs:72-75 and 105-108). Both postfixes ignore the result, so a trait granting a psycast-class ability is revealed by a cast that never happened. Add `bool __result` to Patch_AbilityActivate_Local/Global.Postfix and return early when it is false.

findings.title: Likely explanations for 'discovered only when the fire injured a pawn' (unverified)
findings.detail: (1) CompAbilityEffect_FireSpew.Apply hands its damage to GenExplosion.DoExplosion (CompAbilityEffect_FireSpew.cs:26); if, as I believe, that damage spreads over the next few ticks, the cast-tick discovery and the injury would look like one moment to the user. (2) PlayerCanObserve returns false when the titan's cell is fogged (TitanUtility.cs:228); Firebreather is only discovered by UsesGrantedAbility or Dies, so nothing re-checks it when the fire lands. (3) Notify_PawnPostApplyDamage tries TakesDamage on every trait of a damaged titan (Hediff_Titan.cs:640), so the message may have been the victim's trait, not the caster's. Check run #31's log and the message's pawn label before choosing a fix.

findings.title: UsesGrantedAbility check in Notify_PawnUsedVerb is now redundant
findings.detail: The postfix runs first in the same TryCastNextBurstShot call, so by the time Notify_PawnUsedVerb runs the trait is already discovered and the ability branch at Hediff_Titan.cs:668-669 never fires. Harmless; keeping it is fine as a fallback for ability verbs that don't call Activate.

findings.title: Ability.Activate is not in the Schematic
findings.detail: verify_patches reports both Ability.Activate patches resolve but are not recorded in the Schematic; update_schematic if they stay.

checked: verify_patches on Source/TitanAI.cs: all 3 targets bind, each Ability.Activate patch picks exactly one of the 2 overloads
precedents for Ability.Activate: no corpus mod patches it, so there is no conflict to cite; a postfix is non-destructive
The only corpus override of Ability.Activate is Psycast, and it calls base.Activate on both overloads, so the postfix sees every cast route
The other direct caller of Activate (Ability.cs:659, global cast) is covered by the GlobalTargetInfo postfix
Notify_AbilityActivated: null-safe on def.abilities, reverse loop over traits, discovered guard; GetTitan returns null for a null pawn, and nothing in the corpus calls Activate off the main thread
TF_Example_Firebreather discoverWhen lists UsesGrantedAbility and abilities lists TF_Example_FireBreath (TF_ExampleTraits.xml:254-268)
Verb_CastAbility implements IAbilityVerb, so abilityDef resolves in Notify_PawnUsedVerb
Notify_TraitDiscovered copies hediffs with ToList before changing them, so the vanilla hediff foreach is not invalidated
